input.quote: 26. APPLICABLE LAW. This Agreement shall be governed, construed and interpreted in accordance with the laws of the State of California (without respect to principles of conflicts of law).
input.rationale: Section 26 (p0093) selects California law and Section 27 (p0094) fixes exclusive venue in the state or federal courts located within San Luis Obispo County, California, with consent to jurisdiction and waiver of forum objections. That sits squarely at the fallback position: an accepted governing law (California) with the corresponding California courts as the merits forum. There is no arbitration provision anywhere in the document (searches for arbitration and dispute resolution returned nothing), so the walk-away scenario of mandatory arbitration seated abroad or a foreign exclusive venue does not arise. Short of the preferred position, the law is California rather than New York and the venue is TrueLink's home county (San Luis Obispo) rather than New York County, and the venue clause contains no express carve-out for temporary injunctive relief elsewhere — these are noted rather than redlined because the clause meets every fallback element on its material terms. Per playbook, a clause at the fallback is acceptable and is not redlined.

mappings.quote: Any and all disputes between the parties that cannot be settled by mutual agreement shall be resolved solely and exclusively in the state or federal courts located within San Luis Obispo County, California, and each party consents to the jurisdiction of such courts and irrevocably waives any objections thereto, including without limitation, on the basis of improper venue or forum non conveniens.
